items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: If a French guy played modern jazz, he was also getting booed.

ctx.x: No. It was [dual?]. If a French guy played modern jazz, he was also getting booed. [laughs] You know what I mean? Yeah, it was not just because Belgian.
